title: malouetia tamaquarina var. peruviana
intro: Malouetia tamaquarina var. peruviana, commonly known as Malouetia, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. It is a perennial shrub native to the tropical regions of Peru. Malouetia has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, offering potential benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, wounds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Malouetia include alkaloids and other secondary metabolites, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions like antiviral, antioxidant, and cytotoxic effects, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human use.
